structured_output.summary: The diff implements WeakMap.prototype.has in its file. Step order matches the spec: this_weak_map (RequireInternalSlot) with `?`, then can_be_held_weakly (CanBeHeldWeakly) returning false early, then a table lookup standing in for the step 4 loop. The lookup has no observable side effects, and for object and symbol keys SameValueZero and SameValue agree, so the shortcut is sound. Errors propagate with `?` and there are no fallbacks, special cases or made-up values. The only other change is renaming the unused new_target parameter to _new_target inside the same function, which is cosmetic and in scope. I could not see the helpers in support/collections, so I have not verified that can_be_held_weakly handles registered symbols via KeyForSymbol. The Symbol.for tests fail as not-implemented, so this cannot be checked by test262 yet.
